observations: Photo 0 and 1 show the front of a mono/half-cut cell solar panel, cells split into two horizontal sections (possibly two panels stacked or one split-cell design), with visible glare and reflections
Photo 2 and 3 show the back of a white-backsheet panel with a junction box in the center and two MC4-style connector cables, plus a small printed specification label near the junction box
The specification label in photo 3 is too small and low-resolution to read any wattage, brand, or model number
No visible brand markings, wattage stickers, or model plates are legible in any of the four photos
Timestamps/location metadata on all photos read 'Lagos, Nigeria' despite the buyer's market being Oyo
Background shows a cluttered shop/storage area with other panel stacks, cables, and sacks, consistent with a solar parts dealer

claims.claim: Thank you for contacting Network Solar venture Please let us know how we can help you. We deal...
claims.evidence: No specific product claim (wattage, brand, condition) is made in the text; it is a generic greeting with no verifiable content.

risks.risk: Actual wattage of the panel is unknown; comparables range widely (300w to 650w) with very different prices
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the rear specification/rating label showing wattage, Voc, Isc, and model
risks.if_unproven: cannot be priced at any single worst-case point since the plausible wattage range spans the entire comparable list

risks.risk: Brand/manufacturer unverified, affecting authenticity and resale value (e.g. Canadian Solar, Longi, generic/no-name)
risks.proof: Legible photo of brand name/logo on frame or back label
risks.if_unproven: priced as generic/unbranded, i.e. at the low end of comparable range

risks.risk: New vs used condition not stated; cell cracks, hotspots, or delamination cannot be seen from reflections and glare in photos 0-1
risks.proof: Flat, non-glare daylight photo of full panel face plus a photo of any frame corner damage

risks.risk: Seller location mismatch: photo metadata says Lagos while buyer market is Oyo, raising doubt about current stock location and delivery logistics
risks.proof: Screenshot of seller's current shop location or live video call showing the panel in Oyo
risks.if_unproven: treat as remote/out-of-market stock, added delivery/verification risk

proof_requests: Clear, well-lit close-up of the rear specification label showing wattage, model, and brand
A non-glare daylight photo of the full panel front to check for cracks or cell damage
Confirmation of current physical location of the panel (Oyo vs Lagos) with a recent dated photo or live video
response.reason: The seller's text gives no specification at all and the rear label in the photos is unreadable, so wattage and brand cannot be determined; without that, no single worst-case price can be set given comparables span a very wide range.
